flow_name: Asset Registration & Asset Addition (HOFIN -> HOFA -> HOFIN)
note: Temporary review file. Locators now live in the page classes; the permanent record is automation/element_catalog/vendor_bill_payable.md, asset_registration_pending_review_list.md, hofin_approval_list.md and asset_serial_global_list.md.

steps.locator: Your email address; Password; button Login

steps.business_action: Fill the bill header; Bill Date = the Date field (#transactionDate)
steps.locator: #vendor input, #purchaseMethod input, Bill/Invoice No.: *, #billDate calendar, Total Bill Amount: *, #bankAccount input
steps.note: amount and text boxes need key presses; Bill Date is read-only

steps.business_action: Fill Bill Allocation (project, A/C code, purpose, amount >= 20000) and Add
steps.locator: #project input, #chartOfAccount input, #purpose input, Amount: *, following Add after heading

steps.business_action: Fixed Asset Details popup: registration (no parent) or addition (tick, choose parent serial)
Confirm > Yes, read Transaction No., Submit
Find the Transaction No. and acknowledge
steps.locator: Enter Payable Number(Min 3 char...); Search; row View; button Acknowledge

steps.business_action: Approval > Approval, Feature = Vendor Bill Payable-Vendor, find the Transaction No., Action, Approve
steps.locator: #feature input; #status input; Transaction Number; a.btn-search; row Action; button.btn-info Approve

steps.business_action: Read the newest parent serial; later check the extended asset and the Addition History

open_points: Toast text after Submit ('Transaction Submitted Successfully') was not seen; success is checked by the view screen.
The newest parent serial is read from the top of the Global List; another user registering an asset at the same moment could be picked up.
